description: This file defines internal span utilities and classes for the Abseil C++ library, including data access wrappers, type traits, and comparison functions for span types.

classes.name: absl::Span
classes.description: A template class representing a non-owning view over a contiguous sequence of objects.

classes.name: absl::span_internal::ElementType
classes.description: Type trait to extract the value type from a container.

classes.name: absl::span_internal::IsView
classes.description: Trait to determine if a type is a view with consistent data() return type.

methods.name: GetDataImpl
methods.description: Wrapper function to access data pointer of a container, specialized for std::string and generic containers.

methods.name: GetData
methods.description: Function to retrieve data pointer from a container, using GetDataImpl.

methods.name: HasSize
methods.description: Type trait to check if a container has a size() method returning an integral type.

methods.name: HasData
methods.description: Type trait to check if a container's data() method returns a pointer convertible to T*.

methods.name: ElementType
methods.description: Type trait to extract the element type from a container or array.

methods.name: EqualImpl
methods.description: Function to compare two spans for equality.

methods.name: LessThanImpl
methods.description: Function to lexicographically compare two spans.

methods.name: EnableIfConvertibleTo
methods.description: Type trait enabling template specialization if one type is convertible to another.

methods.name: IsView
methods.description: Trait to determine if a type is a view with consistent data() return type for const and non-const instances.
